tasks.label: Sjekk hvilken nokkel som er lagt inn
tasks.command: cd "${workspaceFolder}" && echo '=== env-navn i rot-.env ==='; grep -oE '^[A-Z0-9_]+=' .env | tr -d '='; echo; echo '=== relevante nokler (kun prefiks) ==='; for k in AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY OPENAI_COMPAT_API_KEY OPENAI_COMPAT_BASE_URL OPENAI_COMPAT_MODEL AGENT_MODEL GROQ_API_KEY CEREBRAS_API_KEY OPENROUTER_API_KEY; do V=$(grep -E "^$k=" .env | head -1 | cut -d= -f2- | tr -d '\"\r'); if [ -n "$V" ]; then printf '%-24s = %s...\n' "$k" "${V:0:8}"; else printf '%-24s = (ikke satt)\n' "$k"; fi; done

tasks.label: List leverandorens modeller
tasks.command: cd "${workspaceFolder}" && BASE=$(grep '^OPENAI_COMPAT_BASE_URL=' .env | cut -d= -f2- | tr -d '\"\r') && KEY=$(grep '^OPENAI_COMPAT_API_KEY=' .env | cut -d= -f2- | tr -d '\"\r') && echo "BASE_URL : $BASE" && echo "MODEL    : $(grep '^OPENAI_COMPAT_MODEL=' .env | cut -d= -f2- | tr -d '\"\r')" && echo "CTX      : $(grep '^OPENAI_COMPAT_CONTEXT_TOKENS=' .env | cut -d= -f2- | tr -d '\"\r')" && echo && echo '=== tilgjengelige modeller hos leverandoren ===' && curl -s --max-time 20 "$BASE/models" -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" | node -e "let s='';process.stdin.on('data',d=>s+=d).on('end',()=>{try{const j=JSON.parse(s);const a=j.data||j.models||[];console.log('antall:',a.length);a.map(m=>m.id).sort().forEach(id=>console.log(' -',id))}catch(e){console.log('raw:',s.slice(0,400))}})"

tasks.label: Bench: Groq-modeller
tasks.command: cd "${workspaceFolder}" && BENCH_MODELS="llama-3.3-70b-versatile,openai/gpt-oss-120b,openai/gpt-oss-20b,qwen/qwen3.8-27b,allam-2-7b" BENCH_RUNS=3 npm run bench

tasks.label: Bygg + restart agent (Groq-modell)
tasks.command: cd "${workspaceFolder}" && echo '=== BYGGER AGENT ===' && npm run build 2>&1 | tail -25 && echo '=== RESTARTER myai-agent ===' && sudo systemctl restart myai-agent && sleep 4 && echo '=== STATUS ===' && systemctl is-active myai-agent && echo '=== LOGG (modellvalg) ===' && journalctl -u myai-agent --no-pager -n 30 -o cat 2>&1 | grep -iE 'modell|model|error|listen' | tail -12 && echo '=== HELSE ===' && curl -s -o /dev/null -w 'agent health HTTP %{http_code}\n' --max-time 10 http://127.0.0.1:2000/eve/v1/health

tasks.label: Ende-til-ende test live agent
tasks.command: cd "${workspaceFolder}" && echo '=== ekte samtale mot live-agenten (2000) ==='; time npx eve invoke --url http://127.0.0.1:2000 "Svar kort pa norsk: hva er 2+2?" 2>&1 | head -30; echo; echo '=== web lokalt (3000) ==='; curl -s -o /dev/null -w 'web HTTP %{http_code}\n' --max-time 10 http://127.0.0.1:3000/; echo '=== offentlig via Cloudflare ==='; curl -s -o /dev/null -w 'tech-ai.tech HTTP %{http_code}\n' --max-time 20 https://tech-ai.tech/

tasks.label: Tool-test live agent
tasks.command: cd "${workspaceFolder}" && echo '=== tool-test mot live-agenten ==='; npx eve invoke --url http://127.0.0.1:2000 "Bruk verktoeyet list_memories og si kort hva som ligger i minnet." 2>&1 | head -20

tasks.label: Sjekk CLI-verktoy og naavaerende nedlastinger
tasks.command: cd "${workspaceFolder}" && echo '=== verktoy ==='; for c in bun npx dpkg-deb makensis file objdump python3 sha256sum; do printf '%-12s ' "$c"; command -v "$c" 2>/dev/null || echo 'MANGLER'; done; echo; echo '=== naavaerende artefakter ==='; ls -lh web/public/downloads/; echo; echo '=== live /download i dag (filer) ==='; curl -s --max-time 25 https://tech-ai.tech/download | grep -oE 'tech-ai_[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+_[a-z0-9_]*\.(deb|exe)' | sort -u; echo; echo '=== live /download (storrelser) ==='; curl -s --max-time 25 https://tech-ai.tech/download | grep -oE 'Download [0-9.]+ (MB|KB|B)' | sort -u

tasks.label: Bygg CLI deb + exe
tasks.command: cd "${workspaceFolder}" && bash scripts/build-cli.sh 2>&1 | tail -45

tasks.label: Verifiser download-side etter bygg
tasks.command: cd "${workspaceFolder}" && echo '=== restarter myai-web ===' && sudo systemctl restart myai-web && sleep 6 && systemctl is-active myai-web && echo '=== lokal /download ===' && curl -s -o /dev/null -w 'local /download HTTP %{http_code}\n' --max-time 15 http://127.0.0.1:3000/download && echo '=== live SHA-256 pa /download ===' && curl -s --max-time 25 "https://tech-ai.tech/download?cb=$(date +%s)" | grep -oE 'SHA-256 [0-9a-f]{64}' | sort -u && echo '=== forventet (fra checksums.txt) ===' && cat web/public/downloads/checksums.txt && echo '=== nedlasting av filene (HTTP + bytes) ===' && for f in tech-ai_1.0.0_amd64.deb tech-ai_1.0.0_windows_x64.exe tech-ai_1.0.0_windows_x64_setup.exe; do printf '%-40s ' "$f"; curl -s -o /dev/null -w 'HTTP %{http_code}  %{size_download} bytes\n' --max-time 60 "https://tech-ai.tech/downloads/$f"; done

tasks.label: Bekreft nye hasher pa live-siden
tasks.command: cd "${workspaceFolder}" && H=$(curl -s --max-time 25 https://tech-ai.tech/download); echo '=== nye hasher funnet pa live-siden? ==='; for h in 14ff3e3273bbbcd4 ca8cd12a472e69d2 5c9c93dc56c7ca1f; do if printf '%s' "$H" | grep -q "$h"; then echo "  FUNNET   $h..."; else echo "  MANGLER  $h..."; fi; done; echo; echo '=== tekst rundt SHA-256 ==='; printf '%s' "$H" | grep -oE 'SHA-256[^<]{0,80}' | head -5; echo; echo '=== storrelser pa siden ==='; printf '%s' "$H" | grep -oE 'Download[^<]{0,20}' | head -5; echo; echo '=== filnavn pa siden ==='; printf '%s' "$H" | grep -oE 'tech-ai_1\.0\.0_[a-z0-9_]*\.(deb|exe)' | sort -u

tasks.label: Git status og remote
tasks.command: cd "${workspaceFolder}" && echo '=== branch + remote ==='; git branch --show-current; git remote -v; echo; echo '=== status (kort) ==='; git status --short; echo; echo '=== endrede filer (diff --stat) ==='; git --no-pager diff --stat; echo; echo '=== staged? ==='; git --no-pager diff --cached --stat; echo; echo '=== hemmeligheter ignorert? ==='; git check-ignore -v .env web/.env.local 2>&1; echo; echo '=== siste commit ==='; git --no-pager log --oneline -3

tasks.label: Preflight for push
tasks.command: cd "${workspaceFolder}" && bash scripts/preflight.sh 2>&1 | tail -60

tasks.label: Commit og push modellendringer
tasks.command: cd "${workspaceFolder}" && git add -A && echo '=== COMMIT ===' && git commit -m 'Add pluggable model selection and a model-speed benchmark' -m 'agent/agent.ts: pick the model by AGENT_MODEL (AI Gateway) > OPENAI_COMPAT_* (Groq, Cerebras, OpenRouter, Ollama, ...) > OLLAMA_MODEL > DEEPSEEK_API_KEY > free gateway fallback. Add scripts/model-bench.mjs and npm run bench to measure latency, tokens/s and tool-calling; it auto-loads the root .env. Remove 59 throwaway diag/verify/build/push scripts from the repo root and prune .vscode/tasks.json from 156 to 50 tasks. Document the model chain in README and .env.example.' 2>&1 | tail -8 && echo '=== PUSH ===' && GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 git push origin main 2>&1 | tail -8 && echo '=== RESULTAT ===' && git --no-pager log --oneline -2 && git status --short | head -5 && echo '(tomt over = rent tre)'
